crew.overview: The story of the Agojie, the all-female unit of warriors who protected the African Kingdom of Dahomey in the 1800s with skills and a fierceness unlike anything the world has ever seen, and General Nanisca as she trains the next generation of recruits and readies them for battle against an enemy determined to destroy their way of life.
crew.title: The Woman King

details.biography:
Nathan Castle is a South African-born actor, best known for his roles in Eraser: Reborn, Slumber Party Massacre and Reflection Point which he won best actor at the LA International Festigious film festival.

He also has landed roles on HBO's Raised By Wolves, Amazon Prime's series Power as well as the Netflix live action adaptation of One Piece.
details.name: Nathan Castle
